item.title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget

turns.text: Make a silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream. The estimate shown is 90 credits, but my hard limit is 30. If it's over, stop—don't make anything.

dialog.agent:
I didn't make the clip, so no credits were spent.

A silent 5-second widescreen clip costs more than your 30-credit limit. You were shown an estimate of 90 credits, and the tool documentation lists 24 credits per second at 480p (the only resolution your free plan allows), which would be about 120 credits. Either way, it's over 30.

At that rate, 30 credits covers only about 1 second of video. If you'd like something within your limit, these would fit:
- **A 1-second clip** of the paper boat, about 24 credits.
- **A still image** of a paper boat on a stream in widescreen, about 5–10 credits on a free image model.

Let me know if you want either of these, or if you raise your limit for the 5-second clip.
dialog.why: Nothing was made because the clip costs more than the user's 30-credit limit. The reply offers cheaper options (a 1-second clip or a still image) and asks the user to pick one or raise the limit, then waits.
dialog.user: No thanks, I don't want either of those. Since it's over budget, just stop there and don't make anything.

turns.agent: I've stopped there and made nothing, so no credits were spent.
